articles.title: Romania blames Russia for ship attack in the Black Sea

events.summary: Romania has attributed a ship attack in the Black Sea to Russia amid a sharp monthly rise in strikes targeting vessels carrying Ukrainian exports. These attacks disrupt grain and cargo movements through the western Black Sea.
events.why: Attacks on commercial shipping in international corridors threaten global food security and escalate regional conflict risks.

articles.title: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes

events.summary: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck northern Tibet, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54, and destroying hundreds of homes in Nagqu. Search and rescue operations are actively underway amid at least seven recorded aftershocks.
events.why: A deadly natural disaster resulting in significant loss of life, injuries, and residential destruction.

articles.title: M 7.0 - 191 km ENE of Nagqu, China

events.summary: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck 191 km east-northeast of Nagqu, China, at a depth of 18.0 km. The event triggered an Orange PAGER alert with an estimated ShakeMap intensity of VIII.
events.why: Strong seismic events cause significant structural damage and present severe hazards to regional populations.

articles.title: Mothers get nearly eight times more paid leave than fathers – and women pay the price

events.summary: New UN data reveals that mothers globally receive nearly eight times more paid leave than fathers. This disparity places the majority of the care burden on women, impacting families, children, and broader economies.
events.why: Disparities in paid leave structure structural labor inequality and child development outcomes across global workforces.

articles.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says

events.summary: A suspect has been detained following a series of attacks near Paris that left one person dead and five wounded. French President Macron labeled the incident a racist terrorist attack.
events.why: Terrorist violence directly affects public safety and carries sociopolitical ramifications for national security.

articles.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn

events.summary: Denmark has announced a ban on mink farming, reversing its previous stance. The country was formerly the world's largest producer of mink pelts, though the sector has declined recently.
events.why: The permanent phaseout ends a major agricultural industry with implications for animal welfare and global fur supply.

articles.title: Bulgaria: Concerns about security in the Black Sea dominate presidential election campaign

events.summary: Black Sea maritime security concerns and reduced government support for Ukraine have become central issues in Bulgaria's presidential election. The campaign follows recent drone attacks on regional shipping vessels.
events.why: Shifts in electoral sentiment in Black Sea border states can alter regional defense alignments and support for Ukraine.

articles.title: Retired general discusses the U.S. and Israeli plan for possible attack on Iran

events.summary: A retired U.S. general discussed potential U.S. and Israeli planning and strategic objectives for a prospective bombing campaign in Iran.
events.why: Discussions by senior defense figures reflect strategic planning contingencies that carry major regional conflict risks.

articles.title: What we know about war plans that Trump and Netanyahu are drawing up

events.summary: Leaders in the U.S. and Israel have indicated that a new attack on Iran remains an active consideration. Military planning between both nations is reportedly being evaluated.
events.why: Heightened rhetoric of direct military intervention signals volatile risks for wider Middle Eastern stability.

articles.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates

events.summary: Near-record volumes of water are flowing over the Iguazú Falls across the Argentina-Brazil border following a heavy October rainy period. Scientists have attributed the intense precipitation to a Super El Niño event.
events.why: Illustrates regional hydrological extremes driven by large-scale climate phenomena.
